scope: 30 synthetic robustness cases from a separate mismatched/noisy plant. No field data or failure probability claim.

protocol.training: First 70 healthy samples only; internal 70/30 chronological fit check.
protocol.forecast: Fixed inputs at each origin; no future load or hidden fault label supplied.
protocol.detector: Fixed residual thresholds and 3/4-sample persistence; no labels provided to the detector.
protocol.difficulty: Includes mild cooling losses, slowly drifting 2–28 °C sensor offsets, 105–155% loads and 0.1–1.2 °C oil noise; reports misses and false alarms.
protocol.limits: Seeds are reproducible and public, not a permanently sealed test set. One plant family; horizons/origins overlap. No parameter tuning was performed on this report.

reference.method: Bounded first-order oil reference; chronological 70/30 split. Validation uses recorded operating inputs; operational forecasts hold inputs constant.
reference.scope: Reference-fit evidence only. Not a fault classifier, confidence interval, winding calibration or field-life estimate.
